rows.reason: Waiting for morning is left as an unfinished prepositional phrase, without an action or rhyme with pirogov.

rows.quote: И в ней был я в духе и в духе,
rows.reason: The repeated v dukhe does not express a clear relation between the reader and book, and does not rhyme with temnoty.
The observer is introduced but the participial construction has no completed action; glyadya does not rhyme with otdokhnut.
A young woman running into the hut during the blizzard makes a modest coherent scene, despite a slightly comic register; metel/mamzel rhyme.

rows.quote: Мы чиним сеть на дне твоем.
rows.reason: Vdvoyom/tvoyom rhyme, but repairing the same net both on shore and on your bottom introduces an unsupported, unnatural location.

rows.quote: И в ней, как в зеркале, всё то, что в нем,
rows.reason: Vdvoyom/nem rhyme, but a net treated as a mirror and an unidentified masculine referent do not form a clear thought.
Povisla suchya has broken grammatical agreement, while the canopy relation is unclear; no rhyme with metel.

rows.quote: На лавку поглядеть, да и заснуть.
rows.reason: The old man sits, looks at the bench and falls asleep: repetitive but understandable rest; otdokhnut/zasnut rhyme.

rows.quote: На дворе, в сарае, жарко спится.
rows.reason: Drying flax outside and sleeping in a hot barn can share a simple domestic scene; the stacked locations are clumsy, but sushitsya/spitsya rhyme.

rows.quote: На дворе, на дворе, в поле и на дворе,
rows.reason: Repeated courtyard and field locations do not make a natural completed second line and do not rhyme with sushitsya.

rows.quote: И всё, что в ней есть, — всё в цветов.
rows.reason: Pirogov/tsvetov rhyme, but vsyo v tsvetov is ungrammatical and the flower relation to the pies is unclear.
